sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.content: The data controller is STIRP, reachable at info@stirp.it.

sections.title: 2. Data Collected
sections.content: We collect only the email address you voluntarily provide when joining our waitlist.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
sections.content: Your email address is collected solely to notify you when STIRP becomes available and to send you updates related to the service launch.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis
sections.content: The processing of your data is based on your explicit consent, given by checking the consent box and submitting the waitlist form (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

sections.title: 5. Data Storage
sections.content: Your data is stored in Google Sheets, hosted on Google servers. Google operates under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for international data transfers. No data is shared with third parties.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content: Your email will be retained until the official launch of the STIRP service, or until you withdraw your consent, whichever comes first.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content:
Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Rectify inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your data
- Withdraw your consent at any time
- Data portability
- Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@stirp.it.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.content: This website uses only technical cookies necessary for its functioning (language preference and theme). No profiling or analytics cookies are used.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
